title: Robert Pattinson May Exit Batman After Part II
excerpt:
Jeff Sneider's report suggests an early end to Matt Reeves' Batman universe.
The studio has not formally announced the franchise's conclusion.
body_md:
A new report from Jeff Sneider suggests The Batman Part II could be Robert Pattinson's final appearance as Batman and Matt Reeves' final entry in the franchise. Originally envisioned as a trilogy, the series faces an uncertain future after repeated delays.

The sequel to the 2022 film is scheduled for February 2028. The nearly six-year gap and reports that Pattinson is no longer contractually obliged to make a third installment add uncertainty. His new James Bond commitment may also affect his availability.

Previous rumors suggested Pattinson could enter the main DC universe. If Sneider's report proves accurate, that scenario becomes less likely. Other reports link Pattinson's continued participation to Reeves' involvement, although contract details have not been officially disclosed.

These reports should not be treated as a confirmed cancellation of the third film. The studio and actor have yet to publicly announce a definitive decision.
